- Choose-Task startup: read progress, .ralph/current_tasks.md, and .ralph/current_tasks_done.md.
- Active tasks contain no bug entries. Checked task files for <priority> and <blocked_by>; none found among active tasks.
- Completed tasks show Story 2 Task 1 passes true, so Story 2 Task 2 is the next logical unblocked failing task because it designs the PostgreSQL schema needed by later sync/API/document/search stories.
- Wrote .ralph/tasks/story-2-complete-sync-postgres/task-2-design-postgres-schema.md to .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Per Choose-Task instructions, quit immediately after selecting the task.

- Startup restored prior progress and found current task path: .ralph/tasks/story-2-complete-sync-postgres/task-2-design-postgres-schema.md.
- Read task file plus tdd and improve-code-boundaries skill instructions.
- Task has no existing plan marker/NOW EXECUTE, so this is a planning pass. Need inspect official schema model/db crate/docs, write plan under task-2-design-postgres-schema_plans, update task with plan path and NOW EXECUTE, then quit immediately.

- Inspected official_schema API, generated entity metadata, storage docs, Makefile, migrations dir, opentk-db crate, and git status.
- Found migrations currently empty and opentk-db currently only a boundary doc comment.
- Planning decision: avoid muddy boundaries by putting Postgres table/column/index specification generation in opentk-db from opentk-core::official_schema, and keep the migration SQL as generated output verified against that spec.
- Need write the task plan file and update the task footer to point to the plan with NOW EXECUTE, then quit immediately per workflow.

- Created .ralph/tasks/story-2-complete-sync-postgres/task-2-design-postgres-schema_plans/complete-postgres-schema-plan.md.
- The plan ends in NOW EXECUTE and lays out vertical red/green TDD cycles plus a final improve-code-boundaries review.
- Updated .ralph/tasks/story-2-complete-sync-postgres/task-2-design-postgres-schema.md to reference the plan path and end with NOW EXECUTE.
- Per workflow, quit immediately now; next worker should execute the plan, starting with RED 1.

- Restored progress and confirmed current task is story-2 task 2.
- Read task and plan; plan is in NOW EXECUTE state.
- Next: inspect official_schema and opentk-db, then start RED 1 with one public-interface test.

- Completed schema spec implementation through RED/GREEN 1-4 in opentk-db.
- Added public-interface tests for Document, all official entity coverage, scalar field coverage, relation tables, and direct query indexes.
- cargo test -p opentk-db passed with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1; default parallel linking hit transient missing object files on this filesystem.
- Next: add migration text/spec test, generate SQLx up/down migrations, then add PostgreSQL migration integration test.

- Added migration text/spec test and generated reversible SQLx migration files.
- Added PostgreSQL integration test that requires OPENTK_TEST_DATABASE_URL/DATABASE_URL when run directly.
- Updated make test to start a local throwaway PostgreSQL server under target/ and supply OPENTK_TEST_DATABASE_URL.
- make test passed with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 after fixing regclass text decoding.
- Next: run fmt/lint/check, resolve clippy issues, run final make test, then update task status and commit/push if all green.

- Final boundary review completed: schema decisions live in opentk-db::postgres_schema, official entity/field/relation lists are generated from opentk-core, and migration SQL is checked against SchemaSpec.
- Removed migrations/.gitkeep now that real migrations exist.
- Updated plan checkboxes and task acceptance criteria, including marking test-long as not applicable per task instruction.
- Next: rerun final make check/lint/test after metadata edits, then task_switch, commit, push, and quit immediately.
